label: About
title: About Sister Card Field
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from recent saved signals and source research, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: visible marks, objects, and surfaces in the scene open the real sources that shaped the day.

This iteration began with 76 recent saved-signal files and 72 captured links, then narrowed the page to 9 source windows around @archivepilled: birthday card for my sister and Free Floral Birthday Card For Sister Template to Edit Online, plus 7 more. A source image from pbs.twimg.com helped set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became Sister Card Field: Overhead scan of a quiet handmade card field: one pale blue-white paper rectangle lies off-center on teal-gray vine-pattern ground, its curled edge casting a soft shadow. Preserve severe empty paper, graphite wing arcs, a small dense bottom mark with candle-glint apertures, and two cropped diagonal botanical corner... After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped 9 visible regions and the mask audit tightened them against pale fibrous paper field, curled upper-right paper edge, and frayed diagonal repair seam.

typography.rationale: Bricolage Grotesque and Space Grotesk fit record, arcade, and listening-room editions while Fraunces keeps source captions tactile.
